editorial:
Imagine you are hiding away in a quiet lake house, trying to get your life back together after a messy divorce. That is exactly where you find Mort Rainey, a writer who just wants some peace and quiet to work on his next book. Everything seems fine until a creepy guy shows up and accuses Mort of stealing his writing ideas. The vibe is super tense and moody, making you feel like someone is always watching from the trees. You will find yourself wondering if this stranger is actually a psycho or if Mort is just losing his mind from all the stress.

Johnny Depp does a great job playing a guy who seems nervous and innocent, which keeps you guessing until the very end. The plot moves quickly and has a twist that really hits you hard. While some parts of the story feel a bit predictable, the acting keeps it grounded. If you love stories that mess with your head, you should definitely check this one out.
endingExplained: You find out that the creepy stranger, John Shooter, does not actually exist. He is actually a second personality inside Mort's own head. Mort created Shooter to deal with his guilt and stress. Mort was the one who actually committed the crimes and wrote the letters to himself. In the end, the Shooter personality takes over completely, kills the people involved, and leaves Mort's old life behind forever.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves a good twist ending and mind games.
